primaryOutcomeMeasures.description: The primary efficacy endpoint for this study was the proportion of subjects receiving PTG-100 with clinical remission at Week 12. Clinical remission was defined using the Mayo subscores of stool frequency, rectal bleeding, and endoscopy.
